UseAllowed.dsl:
(fn UseAllowed (Target)
  (Utilities|IsValid Target
    (:"Is Valid"
      (if (and (and (not (Variables|Default|GetInteractionBlocked)) (not (Actor|ActorHasTag "Downed"))) (<= (Transformation|GetDistanceTo Target) 400.0))
        (bind _result (Class|BPEnvironmentDoor|CanInteract Target self))
        (if _result
          (bind (_outhit _returnvalue) (Collision|LineTraceByChannel (Actor|GetActorEyesViewPoint) (Transformation|GetActorLocation Target)))
          (return (or (not _returnvalue) (Utilities|Equal(Object) (Collision|BreakHitResult _outhit) Target)))
          (else
            (return false)))
        (else
          (return false))))
    (:"Is Not Valid"
      (return false))))
